description: Use this when the user asks for the history of past results: 'números más salidos', 'números más atrasados', 'qué número salió más en la Provincia'. Returns how often each ending (00-99) came out a la cabeza, overall and in the last 90 days, and the ones absent the longest. Descriptive history only: draws are random and these figures do not predict anything; never use them to suggest numbers to play.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction key or name; omit for all jurisdictions combined.
